page: Microsoft Azure E4ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor operating at 3.7 GHz. The instance delivers 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical cores with 2 threads per core, supported by 32 MB of L3 cache. It provides 32 GB of RAM, resulting in an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio (8 GB per vCPU). Additionally, the server includes a bundled 236 GB local NVMe SSD for fast ephemeral storage, as well as support for AVX-512 and AES instructions.

Benchmark evaluations reveal strong single-core performance, placing in the top 25% for single-threaded stress-ng CPU tests, Geekbench single-core, and text processing tasks. Multi-core CPU scores, PassMark encryption, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput remain average. Conversely, memory bandwidth tests demonstrate lower throughput during large uncached reads and multi-threaded decompression tasks.

The hardware configuration provides high memory density relative to core count, delivering favorable resource efficiency for applications that demand substantial RAM without requiring massive multi-core parallelism. The inclusion of local NVMe storage reduces external disk latency. Tradeoffs include limited uncached memory bandwidth. Microsoft Azure E4ads_v6 is suited for key-value stores, relational databases, web application servers, and text-processing workflows.
description: Microsoft Azure E4ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by a 3.7 GHz AMD EPYC 9V74 processor with 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical cores. It features 32 GB of system memory, yielding an 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU ratio, and includes a 236 GB local NVMe SSD for fast ephemeral storage. Benchmark results show strong single-core CPU execution, ranking in the top 25% for single-threaded stress-ng tests and Geekbench text processing. Multi-core performance and general CPU encryption tests remain average. However, memory bandwidth benchmark results fall into lower tiers for large block read-only access. The hardware profile offers high resource density per vCPU, making it cost-efficient for applications requiring significant memory allocations without high concurrent core demands. Microsoft Azure E4ads_v6 is well suited for key-value stores, relational databases, static web serving, and text processing workloads requiring local storage buffering.
